title: DepositFieldStateMessage
description: Dynamic state of every deposit in the star system, the same for every player. Sent once right after SESSION_READY and, to every session of the world, in every tick in which any deposit's visible state changed (an extraction, or a regeneration step of a revealed, not-full deposit). Always the full list in ascending deposit_id order. Positions, radii and names are static and come from the client's copy of the deposit table; THE CLIENT MUST NOT READ A DEPOSIT'S MINERAL FROM THAT COPY - only from this message (design doc section 3.2). A deposit nobody has extracted from yet is UNREVEALED: mineral_id, initial_reserve_kg, remaining_kg and first_extracted_tick are ALL null, so the message cannot leak what it holds (spec p1-02 I-68). A revealed deposit has all four non-null and stays revealed forever, even when regeneration refills it. The schema cannot express 'all four null together'; the server enforces it and QA checks it with a positive control. Not a response to any command.

mineral_id.description: Null until the first extraction reveals the deposit.

initial_reserve_kg.description: Null while unrevealed (the reserve size would give the mineral away).

remaining_kg.description: Remainder at this tick after lazy regeneration (ADR-0013 section 1). Null while unrevealed. 0 = depleted.

first_extracted_tick.description: Tick of the extraction that revealed the deposit. Null while unrevealed.
